This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior System Administrator (IST Time Zone) based in Romania.
 We are looking for a skilled and motivated Senior System Administrator to support and maintain a reliable, secure, and high-performing IT infrastructure. In this role, you will contribute to daily system operations, infrastructure monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will work closely with engineering teams to ensure system stability, resolve technical issues, and optimize operational processes. The position offers opportunities to strengthen automation practices and contribute to scalable infrastructure solutions. You will operate in a collaborative, international environment where technical expertise, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence are highly valued. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while continuing to develop your expertise in systems administration and modern infrastructure technologies.
 Accountabilities
Monitor system health, availability, and performance, proactively identifying and resolving operational issues to maintain reliable infrastructure.
Perform system administration activities, including software updates, security patching, configuration management, and user access administration.
Troubleshoot Linux and Windows environments, investigate incidents, and implement effective solutions to minimize operational disruptions.
Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, including operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and troubleshooting guidelines.
Identify opportunities to streamline infrastructure operations through automation and contribute to developing scripts, tools, and repeatable processes.
Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to improve infrastructure visibility and incident response.
Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to implement best practices, improve system reliability, and support continuous infrastructure optimization.
Contribute to the development of scalable operational processes and support the evolution of infrastructure and DevOps practices.
 Requirements
At least 4 years of professional experience in IT operations, system administration, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical field.
Solid foundational knowledge of Linux and/or Windows system administration, including system configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, DNS, connectivity, and basic network troubleshooting.
Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent solutions.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, with an understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals.
Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash, and an interest in developing automation capabilities.
Understanding of automation practices and an interest in DevOps methodologies and infrastructure optimization.
Familiarity with version control systems such as Git is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to document technical processes and solutions clearly and effectively.
Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within distributed, international teams.
Proactive mindset, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for solving technical challenges and improving operational efficiency.
Ability to work in alignment with the IST time zone.
 Benefits
Flexible working arrangements, including remote, office-based, or hybrid options.
Competitive salary and comprehensive compensation package.
Personalized career development and growth opportunities.
Professional development resources, including mentorship programs, technical talks, training sessions, and centers of excellence.
Access to active technical communities and regular knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Education and professional development reimbursement.
Memorable anniversary gifts and recognition initiatives.
Corporate events, team-building activities, and opportunities to connect with colleagues.
Additional location-specific benefits.
Please note that certain benefits may not apply to freelancers.
